positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Western Logistics provides warehousing and transportation services to the biggest Liquor importers in the US.

I was the main developer for all the websites owned by the company. These websites provided several reports to our warehousing and transportation customers, including open orders, shipped orders, inventory reports, etc.

All these websites were developed in ASP.NET.
